name: 终极井字棋
tagline: 井字棋中的井字棋：你的每一步都决定对手下在哪里。
description: 在浏览器中免费玩终极井字棋：九个小棋盘，一局大游戏，也可玩经典井字棋。对战机器人、双人或在线对战。
about: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe takes the game everyone knows and makes it a real strategy game. The board is nine small tic-tac-toe boards arranged in a big 3 × 3 grid. Win a small board by getting three in a row on it, and win the game by winning three small boards in a row.

The twist is where you're allowed to play. The cell you choose inside a small board sends your opponent to the small board in the same position on the big grid. Play in the top-right cell, and your opponent must play in the top-right board. So every move is two decisions: what it does on its own board, and where it sends the other player. If you're sent to a board that's already won or full, you may play in any open board.
If you just want a quick game, classic tic-tac-toe is here too, on a single 3 × 3 board. Play against a bot on three levels, with a friend on one device, or online.
howToPlay: Choose Ultimate or Classic, then Play vs bots or Play on this device. The first player starts and may play anywhere.
Place your mark in an empty cell of the highlighted board or boards.
Where you play inside a small board decides which small board your opponent plays in next.
Three in a row on a small board wins it. A board that fills up with no line counts for nobody. If you're sent to a won or full board, play in any open one.
Win three small boards in a row, across, down or diagonally, to win the game. If no line of boards is possible, it's a draw. In Classic, three in a row on the one board wins.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a cell in a highlighted board.
Mouse: click a cell in a highlighted board.
Keyboard: move across the whole grid with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space to play.
Against bots, Undo takes back your last move and the bot's reply.
tips: Before you play a cell, look at the board it sends your opponent to. A good move on one board can hand them an easy win on another.
Sending your opponent to a board that's already won lets them play anywhere, which is usually a gift.
The centre board matters most, as it's part of four lines of boards.
Sometimes it's worth giving up a small board to keep your opponent away from the one you need.
In Classic, the first player can't be beaten by perfect play, but never wins against it either: take the centre or a corner.

faq.question: Is Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Where can I play?
faq.answer: In the board the highlighting shows: the one matching the cell your opponent last played. If that board is won or full, any open board is highlighted.

faq.question: What happens to a full board with no winner?
faq.answer: It counts for nobody. If no line of three won boards is still possible, the game is a draw.

faq.question: How strong are the bots?
faq.answer: In Ultimate they play out many random games to choose a move; easy also plays at random now and then. In Classic, hard never loses.
